report: Revision pairing theorems (SPEC section 9): T1, T2 and the quantum-level reading, verified exactly in WolframScript for both statistics
coordinates: x1, x2, x3 = 3-space; x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = the exponentially deflating extra times; x8 = the hidden direction

checks.name: fixture_Clifford_relation
checks.detail: Revision/algebra/gammas.json read: {gamma^a, gamma^b} = 2 eta^ab I16 re-checked for all 64 pairs, eta = diag(+1,+1,+1,-1,-1,-1,-1,+1) in the order x1..x8 (x4 the time, x5, x6, x7 the deflating extra times, x8 the hidden direction)

checks.name: fixture_definitions
checks.detail: C = gamma^(x8) gamma^(x1) gamma^(x2) gamma^(x3), Gamma = gamma^(x8) gamma^(x1) ... gamma^(x7), B = -i C gamma^(x4), S^ab = (1/4)[gamma^a, gamma^b] re-derived from the fixture gammas

checks.name: Gamma_properties
checks.detail: Gamma = diag(-I8, I8) is real, symmetric, Gamma^2 = I; {Gamma, gamma^a} = 0 for all a; [Gamma, C] = 0; [Gamma, S^ab] = 0 for all a, b (hence [Gamma, Omega_mu] = 0 for ANY connection Omega_mu = (1/2) omega_mu ab S^ab)

checks.name: C_and_B_basic
checks.detail: C real symmetric with C^2 = I; B Hermitian with B^2 = I; C gamma^(x4) = i B (so the x4-derivative kernel of L is (i/2) sqrt|g| e^(x4)_(x4) B)

checks.name: T1_kernel_scalar
checks.detail: Gamma C Gamma = C: S = Psibar Psi = Psi^dagger C Psi is INVARIANT under Psi -> Gamma Psi (Psibar -> Psibar Gamma since Gamma is real symmetric and commutes with C)

checks.name: T1_kernel_kinetic
checks.detail: Gamma C gamma^a Gamma = -C gamma^a for a = x1..x8: every kinetic bilinear Psibar gamma^a d_mu Psi and (d_mu Psibar) gamma^a Psi, and every current Psibar gamma^a Psi, CHANGES SIGN

checks.name: T1_kernel_connection
checks.detail: Gamma C {gamma^a, S^bc} Gamma = -C {gamma^a, S^bc} for all 512 triples: the spin-connection part (1/4) e^mu_a omega_mu bc Psibar {gamma^a, S^bc} Psi of the symmetrised kinetic term changes sign for ANY vielbein and ANY connection coefficients

checks.name: T1_kernel_field_equation
checks.detail: Gamma gamma^a Gamma = -gamma^a and Gamma S^bc Gamma = S^bc: gamma^mu D_mu (Gamma Psi) = -Gamma gamma^mu D_mu Psi for any vielbein and any connection Omega_mu = (1/2) omega_mu bc S^bc

checks.name: T1_linearity_argument
checks.detail: L = sqrt|g| [ (1/2) e^mu_a (Psibar gamma^a d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^a Psi) + (1/4) e^mu_a omega_mu bc Psibar {gamma^a, S^bc} Psi - m S - (lambda/2) S^2 ] is a sum of coefficients (functions of the field: sqrt|g|, e^mu_a, omega_mu bc) times the kernel bilinears above; T_mu nu, J^mu and E_(m,lambda) likewise. The kernels transform with the signs above, the coefficients are untouched, so L_(m,lambda)[Gamma Psi] = -L_(-m,-lambda)[Psi], T_(-m,-lambda)[Gamma Psi] = -T_(m,lambda)[Psi], J[Gamma Psi] = -J[Psi], E_(-m,-lambda)[Gamma Psi] = -Gamma E_(m,lambda)[Psi] hold in EVERY gravitational field (any vielbein, any spin connection) and for both statistics (Psi -> Gamma Psi substitutes each component by +-itself and never reorders Grassmann factors)

checks.name: T2_Pn_in_Pin44
checks.detail: P_n = Gamma gamma^n equals +- the ordered product of the seven other gammas (signs x1:1, x2:-1, x3:1, x4:1, x5:-1, x6:1, x7:-1, x8:-1): a product of unit vectors, hence an element of Pin(4,4)

checks.name: T2_Pn_covers_the_reflection
checks.detail: P_n^-1 gamma^a P_n = (R_n)^a_b gamma^b for every n, with R_n the reflection of the frame direction n: P_n acts on the gammas exactly as the O(4,4) reflection R_n (ordinary adjoint action), so it is the spinor lift that commutes with the Dirac operator

checks.name: T2_character_of_Pn
checks.detail: P_n^dagger C P_n = chi_n C with chi_n = -eta_nn: character -1 (S -> -S) for the space-like directions x1, x2, x3, x8, character +1 for the time-like x4, x5, x6, x7 (x1:-1, x2:-1, x3:-1, x4:1, x5:1, x6:1, x7:1, x8:-1)

checks.name: T2_Gamma_times_Pn_is_gamma_n
checks.detail: Gamma P_n = gamma^n (Gamma^2 = I): the T2 map 'Gamma combined with the reflection P_n' acts on the spinor as gamma^n

checks.name: T2_kernels_gamma_n_with_frame_reflection
checks.detail: for M = gamma^n and the reflected frame (e'^a = (R_n)^a_b e^b): M^dagger C M = -eta_nn C, M^dagger C gamma^a M = eta_nn (R_n)^a_b C gamma^b, M^dagger C {gamma^a, S^bc} M = eta_nn R R R C {gamma, S}: for n space-like (character -1) the kinetic term is INVARIANT and S -> -S, hence L_(m,lambda)[gamma^n Psi; R_n e] = +L_(-m,lambda)[Psi; e] in every field (T2); for n time-like the kinetic term changes sign and S is invariant, hence L -> -L_(-m,-lambda) (a T1-type map, not T2)

checks.name: primordial_vielbein
checks.detail: the diagonal vielbein e^a_mu = sqrt|g_mumu| (e^a4 sin^(1/6) z for x1..x3, 1 for x4, e^-a4 sin^(1/6) z for x5..x7, cot z for x8; z = 6 H x8 in (0, pi/2)) gives E^T eta E = the author's metric of SPEC section 1 exactly and sqrt|g| = det E = cos z

checks.name: pointwise_field_is_general
checks.detail: the pointwise test field: e^a_mu = delta^a_mu + ((2a + 3mu) mod 5 - 2)/9 and d_rho e^a_mu = ((a + 2mu + 3rho) mod 7 - 3)/11 at one point (exact rationals), det e = 1411/6561 != 0; the metric is non-diagonal and 448 of the 512 connection components omega_mu ab are nonzero: a generic field with all frame directions coupled

checks.name: connection_primordial
checks.detail: field 'primordial': the canonical spin connection computed from the vielbein (Christoffel symbols of g = E^T eta E) satisfies omega_mu ab = -omega_mu ba and the vielbein postulate d_mu gamma^nu + Chr^nu_(mu lambda) gamma^lambda + [Omega_mu, gamma^nu] = 0 exactly (all 64 matrix components)

checks.name: T1_scalar_and_kinetic_primordial_commuting
checks.detail: field 'primordial', commuting (dirac16complex00): S[Gamma Psi] = S[Psi], S^2[Gamma Psi] = S^2[Psi], K[Gamma Psi] = -K[Psi] (K the symmetrised kinetic term including the spin connection)

checks.name: T1_Lagrangian_primordial_commuting
checks.detail: field 'primordial', commuting (dirac16complex00): L_(m,lambda)[Gamma Psi] + L_(-m,-lambda)[Psi] = 0 identically in the jets (L has 408 monomials)

checks.name: T1_Lagrangian_negative_controls_primordial_commuting
checks.detail: field 'primordial', commuting (dirac16complex00): L_(m,lambda)[Gamma Psi] + L_(m,lambda)[Psi] != 0 and L_(m,lambda)[Gamma Psi] + L_(-m,lambda)[Psi] != 0: the mass AND the coupling must change sign (for lambda != 0) - T1 pairs (m, lambda) with (-m, -lambda)

checks.name: T1_field_equation_covariance_primordial_commuting
checks.detail: field 'primordial', commuting (dirac16complex00): E_(-m,-lambda)[Gamma Psi] = -Gamma E_(m,lambda)[Psi] (E = gamma^mu D_mu Psi - (m + lambda S) Psi): Psi solves the (m, lambda) equation iff Gamma Psi solves the (-m, -lambda) equation

checks.name: T1_Euler_Lagrange_derived_primordial_commuting
checks.detail: field 'primordial', commuting (dirac16complex00): the Euler-Lagrange expressions derived from L_(m,lambda) (ordinary derivatives, total derivatives d_mu including the field-dependent coefficients) equal sqrt|g| C (gamma^mu D_mu Psi - (m + lambda S) Psi) and sqrt|g| ( -(D_mu Psibar) gamma^mu - (m + lambda S) Psibar ) exactly

checks.name: T1_Euler_Lagrange_map_primordial_commuting
checks.detail: field 'primordial', commuting (dirac16complex00): [Euler-Lagrange expressions of L_(-m,-lambda)] evaluated at Gamma Psi = -Gamma [those of L_(m,lambda)] at Psi, for the Psi^dagger and the Psi variation: solutions are mapped to solutions

checks.name: T1_energy_momentum_primordial_commuting
checks.detail: field 'primordial', commuting (dirac16complex00): T_mu nu is symmetric and T^(-m,-lambda)_mu nu[Gamma Psi] + T^(m,lambda)_mu nu[Psi] = 0 for all 64 components (off shell, hence also on shell): the pair's total energy-momentum density vanishes
